_why: The registry selects the Meta-Harness that edits candidate trees in an experiment. Each run records the selected CLI, resolved version and model. The DSH headless profile is the shipped default.

codex.name: codex
codex.note: The upstream Codex CLI, unmodified. `latest` because the first question a user asks is 'can I use the current one' -- and because the version actually used is recorded, so this stays reproducible in the only sense that matters: a number always says what produced it.

dsh.name: dsh
dsh.note: The DSH CLI edits the candidate workspace with read, edit and shell tools. The headless profile uses the deepseek-official provider and the deepseek-flash model. HG_DSH_ROOT selects its built checkout and HG_IMPROVER_DSH_HOME its prepared home. The resolver records the CLI version and Node and CLI content hashes. The method receives a copy of the selected home and the credential named by api_key_env.
